video_title: NBA’s BIGGEST Offseason Moves: LeBron, Kawhi, The Warriors | Channing's Mailbag

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston Celtics winning the championship would be the greatest run of all time
quotes.excerpt: If the Boston Celtics win this year, it's the greatest championship run of all time.
quotes.quote: If the Boston Celtics win this year, it's the greatest championship run of all time.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Caruso is the most bald-headed player in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Alex Caruso is the most bald-headed sucker in the NBA. He's the bald demon.
quotes.quote: Alex Caruso is the most bald-headed sucker in the NBA. He's the bald demon.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green will stay with the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Draymond Green is not leaving the luscious warm confines of San Francisco.
quotes.quote: Draymond Green is not leaving the luscious warm confines of San Francisco. That man is going to get a statue alongside Klay and Steph, and honestly, he is the engine that holds that defense down.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye's top players he wishes he could have played with
quotes.excerpt: Jason Kidd, Kobe, and Tim Duncan. And honestly, Dirk would have been fourth.
quotes.quote: Jason Kidd, Kobe, and Tim Duncan. And honestly, Dirk would have been fourth. That would have been amazing to play with those guys, but Jason Kidd for sure. I grew up watching him, and he was just one of the most underrated point guards ever.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye would love to play with Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: I'll play with Jokic all day. I like to shoot the ball, so I need somebody passing that rock.
quotes.quote: I'll play with Jokic all day. I like to shoot the ball, so I need somebody passing that rock. So I'll play with Jokic. I'll play with Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama has a lot to prove to be considered the greatest
quotes.excerpt: As great as he is, and as much as he's accomplished, he still has a lot to earn.
quotes.quote: As great as he is, and as much as he's accomplished, he still has a lot to earn. Everyone's like, 'Oh, he's going to be the greatest,' but it's like, you know how much he has to do to even be in a conversation of top 10 or to be top 25? That's not an easy list.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum is not having a Kobe 2006-style season
quotes.excerpt: Not a chance. I don't know if you've seen some of these other teams, not a chance.
quotes.quote: Not a chance. I don't know if you've seen some of these other teams, not a chance. Hell to the no. That would be the greatest, if the Boston Celtics win this year, I'm going to say it's the greatest championship run of all time.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The New York Knicks are unlikely to repeat as champions
quotes.excerpt: I don't think it's a hangover thing. I think a lot of things have to go right.
quotes.quote: I don't think it's a hangover thing. I think a lot of things have to go right in this league, and the way that the CBA is structured, it does not reward you for winning a championship. Think about how many things that go in place for the Knicks. Think about them having to get KAT. Think about how much they had to build not only through trades, but getting guys to buy in, finding the right coach at the right time. There are so many minute details. Jaylen Williams has a whole season where his hamstring is cooked. So then, I don't think that the Knicks are going to have a championship hangover. I just don't think they're built like that.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet should not be traded by the Houston Rockets
quotes.excerpt: I'm not trading him. I haven't even seen if it works. I haven't even seen if the Houston Rockets idea works.
quotes.quote: I'm not trading him. I haven't even seen if it works. I haven't even seen if the Houston Rockets idea works. And I'll say this, the Houston Rockets need a true court leader. They need somebody to put the young guys in the right positions to talk to them, somebody that they trust. I think KD is a moon. He's a gigantic moon, and he's going to create waves, but he can't provide life for your team. If that makes any sense, right? KD, the waves are going to help everything, but he is not I just don't see him as a teacher like that, where Fred VanVleet is going to be a teacher and an emotional leader.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA players receive 24-hour medical care for injuries
quotes.excerpt: It's almost 24-hour care for any injury. I'm not a big take Advil guy.
quotes.quote: It's almost 24-hour care for any injury. I'm not a big take Advil guy, I'm not a big pill guy, but sometimes when you have something that's naggy, it actually helps you lock in more. Because if I'm feeling good, and honestly, you're never feeling good. You never feel spry or 100% because your attitude in a league is like, 'How do you get 100% better from Monday to Tuesday?' You got to basically die on Monday. You got to basically die on Monday, recover yourself 100% or as much as you can, and repeat that every single day.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA coaches are more like therapists than coaches
quotes.excerpt: In all actuality, you're more of a therapist than a coach half the time.
quotes.quote: In all actuality, you're more of a therapist than a coach half the time. Your job is to manage egos. Your job is to overly communicate in a way that makes sense to earn trust of alpha males. Extreme alpha males. And now you're telling them, 'Hey, sacrifice. Hey, buy into my system, buy into what my vision is.' And what happens if your vision is, 'Hey, you're coming off the bench' because of X, Y, and Z? The issue is a coach is trying to do his job, what's best for the team. The player is trying to do what's best for the team, but also what's best for him. How did Gregg Popovich get Manu Ginobili, a Hall of Fame guy who should have started on every team in NBA, to go, 'Hey, you're just going to come off the bench always'?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's health is the biggest concern for the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: I think defensively, this team is going to be sick. It's hard for me to trust Kawhi Leonard in his health.
quotes.quote: I think defensively, this team is going to be sick. It's hard for me to trust Kawhi Leonard in his health. It's hard for me to do that. Now, you're going to say, 'Well, what about last year?' Last year was contract year. It's kind of funny how that works, right? Damn, that dude was healthy as shit that year. I think they're going to compete. I think they'll be a top-five team in the East. They've realized that like Scottie Barnes is talented as he is, him and Brandon Ingram were not going to work well together. Scotty Barnes needs somebody like him to create shots on his own, but also not want to take his mantle of leader and all-star and stuff like that. This is Scottie Barnes' team, it's just Kawhi just happens to be there.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State Warriors will struggle after Stephen Curry retires
quotes.excerpt: The minute Steph is gone, you're going to be garbage for a little bit.
quotes.quote: The minute Steph is gone, you're going to be garbage for a little bit. But you have to, because you're going to have to build through the draft. If you think about why Golden State was great, an all-time great team, top three greatest team ever, they built through the draft. You drafted Klay Thompson, you drafted Steph Curry, you drafted Draymond Green, and then you added the right pieces with them. I don't know if you've drafted well lately. Over the last 10 years, you have drafted pretty crappy. I don't even know if you have any of your draft picks still. But you just haven't hit the lottery yet with one of those picks. I thought you put a lot of pressure on Jonathan Kuminga.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland is not a viable destination for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Why hasn't anyone mentioned Portland as a destination for James? Because that's not going to make sense.
quotes.quote: Why hasn't anyone mentioned Portland as a destination for James? Because that's not going to make sense. Undersized guard, young big, not enough scoring. Denny Avdija is amazing, Damian Lillard is amazing, Ja Morant is obviously amazing, and then you add LeBron, you're not that setup ain't beating anybody. I don't know if you've seen the Western Conference, brother, but there are some gorillas out there.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Minnesota Timberwolves are the top team in free agency
quotes.excerpt: One, Timberwolves. I believe Chris Finch's culture, Anthony Edwards' culture is going to help LaMelo.
quotes.quote: One, Timberwolves. I believe Chris Finch's culture, Anthony Edwards' culture is going to help LaMelo. But LaMelo's enthusiasm for basketball is going to help them and also keep the pace of the game for them up, and they got younger. That's one. I thought Kawhi Leonard was huge for Toronto, starting to go for it. And then obviously, the biggest one, by far, is Jaylen Brown going to Philly. I think Philly has said, 'Hey, we can't move Joel Embiid's contract. We can't move, I mean, we got to move someone's contract. Who's going to take Paul George?' So instead of trying to rebuild, you're saying, 'Hey, Joel Embiid, let's say you got two years left, three years left, whatever it is on your body, I'm going to go for it.' I'm going to go for it now, and you add a guy, Finals MVP, a guy that fits Philly's culture. He fits in that, in that city. And to me, I think when you have a chance to go for it, you go for it. Because if Joel Embiid is even 60% healthy, he's one of the top five best players in NBA.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.excerpt: Steph, Kobe, LeBron, KG, and Shaq. So here's the difference. Bird of the first group, Bird would get cooked by Kobe or LeBron.
quotes.quote: Steph, Kobe, LeBron, KG, and Shaq. So here's the difference. Bird of the first group, Bird would get cooked by Kobe or LeBron. Defensively, defensively. But on the second group, Steph would get posted up by Magic, MJ, Bird. Okay? But then you look at Hakeem in his prime versus Shaq in his prime. Hakeem was giving Shaq the business in his prime. So, Tim Duncan was giving KG the business in their prime. MJ, Kobe are going to even themselves out. So really, it's LeBron versus Magic. I'm taking LeBron. So, I'm going to have to say, I'll take Steph, Kobe, LeBron, KG, and Shaq. I got to go with size. I got to go with size.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.excerpt: When you do something that has never been done and may never been done, and you're averaging.
quotes.quote: When you do something that has never been done and may never been done, and you're averaging basically a 30-point triple-double doing that versus a 73-and-9 team, and then two years later, you lead both teams in points, rebounds, assists, steals, and blocks. Brother, I don't know how much more clutch that is. What is your definition of clutch? Like, you're being stupy? What are we doing?
